## Education

- **Seattle University** — M.S., Business Analytics (STEM), 2020
- **University of Cincinnati (DAAP)** — M.S., Architecture (Urban Development), 2011
- **Hebei University of Technology** — B.Eng., Urban Planning & Design, 2008  

## Research Interests

- **Climate-Resilient Urban Development & Sustainable Real Estate Investment:** AI-based evaluation of climate risk and resilience benefits in real estate and urban development decisions.
- **Interpretable, Equity-Aware ML for Modifiable Urban Form:** identifying *modifiable* siting and built-form characteristics that reduce climate vulnerability and unequal impacts.
- **Policy Translation & Decision Rules:** converting model insights into implementable **public investment prioritization rules** for capital improvement planning, hazard mitigation, and housing policy.
- **Built-Environment Performance Modeling (for features/validation):** CFD, thermal comfort, energy, daylight/radiation analysis to support feature generation and ground-truthing.
